commits.message:
feat(render): renderToString takes onStyleError (rich-diagnostics-ejn)

renderToString degraded an unparseable style to unstyled with no way for
its caller to hear about it or make the render strict. It now takes the
same StyleErrorHandler a Console does and hands it to the RenderOptions
it builds, so both share RenderOptions.onStyleError's contract.

fix(live): a frame that throws leaves the terminal usable (rich-live-vu8) (#220)

* fix(live): a frame that throws leaves the terminal usable (rich-live-vu8)

refresh() rendered after erasing the last frame, so a render that threw
left nothing on screen; on the auto-refresh timer the throw escaped with
stop() never run, leaving the cursor hidden and the alternate screen up.

The frame is now rendered before any byte is written, and the erase or
cursor-home goes out in the same write as the new frame. Handing the
terminal back is one _release(), run by stop() in a finally and by the
timer before it rethrows.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(live): a frame is drawn only while Live holds the terminal (rich-live-vu8)

After the auto-refresh timer handed the terminal back, a caller's later
refresh() painted onto the main screen and its stop() did nothing to undo
it. refresh() before start() or after stop() did the same. Now no frame is
drawn outside start()/stop(), as in Rich.

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
